info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Meetings Meetings Join-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the joining of scheduled meetings for users within the platform. By providing the necessary meeting credentials, participants can seamlessly connect to active sessions. Typical consumers of this API include employees, clients, or collaborators requiring access to meetings for discussions or presentations. This endpoint supports efficient participation in meetings, enhancing collaboration and communication efforts.

post.description: This endpoint allows a user to join an existing meeting by providing the necessary meeting credentials. After successful joining, users can participate in the meeting as per their roles.

requestBody.description: Request body for joining a meeting. This payload should contain the necessary details required to successfully join a meeting session. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly.
